tagline: Embed Figma designs in Notion pages and sync design status
metaTitle: Figma + Notion Integration: Live Designs Inside Your Docs
metaDescription: Keep Notion project pages showing the current design. GAIA embeds live Figma frames and syncs each design's status to your Notion database. See the setup steps.
intro:
Product and design teams maintain Notion pages for requirements and specifications while the actual designs live in Figma. The disconnect means that documents reference outdated screenshots instead of live designs, and design status updates never reach the project tracking databases in Notion.

GAIA links the two so designs are always embedded live in the right pages and design status flows into databases automatically. When a designer marks a frame ready, the feature page reflects it. When a new feature page is created, GAIA creates a linked file ready for design work.

useCases.title: Embed live Figma frames in Notion pages
useCases.description: When a new frame is created for a feature, GAIA embeds it live in the corresponding page. Stakeholders always see the current design, not a stale screenshot.

useCases.title: Sync design status to the project database
useCases.description: When a file's status changes to 'Ready for Review,' GAIA updates the project database record. Product managers see design progress without leaving Notion.

useCases.title: Create Figma files from Notion project pages
useCases.description: When a new feature is created in the product database, GAIA creates a corresponding file from your team's template. Design starts organized and linked from day one.

useCases.title: Log version history in the documentation
useCases.description: Each time a version is published, GAIA appends an entry to the design history table on the page. Teams maintain a clear design changelog inside their documentation.

howItWorks.step: Connect Figma and Notion to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Authorize GAIA with your Figma account and Notion workspace. GAIA maps design projects to the corresponding databases.

howItWorks.step: Configure embedding rules and status mappings
howItWorks.description: Define which files embed in which pages and how status tags map to database properties. GAIA maintains these links automatically.
Updates move between the two in real time. Designs are embedded live, statuses are updated, and version history is logged without manual intervention.

faqs.question: Are Figma embeds in Notion live or static images?
faqs.answer: GAIA uses the file's embed URL to insert live, interactive embeds. Viewers see the current design and can navigate frames directly within the page.

faqs.question: Can GAIA sync design comments to the page?
faqs.answer: Yes. Comment threads can be mirrored to a comments section of the page, giving anyone without a design-tool account visibility into design feedback.

faqs.question: Does this work with branches?
faqs.answer: GAIA can track specific branches and reflect branch status on the page. When a branch is merged, the page status updates accordingly.
